meta.local_frame: x = metres east, y = metres north of origin (equirectangular approx, good to <1 m within 2 km)
meta.size_m_convention: w = east-west extent, d = north-south extent, h = height above ground. Footprint numbers come from OSM polygons (see footprints.geojson); heights are marked with their source in notes. 'est' = estimated from CC photos, verify with Street View.
meta.orientation_deg: bearing of the building's long axis / facing direction, 0 = north, 90 = east

landmarks.name_th: อนุสาวรีย์ท้าวสุรนารี (ย่าโม)
landmarks.notes: Bronze statue 1.85 m tall, 325 kg (NRRU Khorat Geopark). Standing pose: right hand holds a sword with the tip resting on the ground, left hand on hip, full court dress with shoulder sash (confirmed in monument-01.jpg). Faces WEST toward Bangkok (NRRU) — players driving east along Ratchadamnoen / Chumphon approach see her face. 26x26 m = OSM raised terrace (ฐานไพที) with steps on all sides; white pedestal ~3-3.5 m [est from plaza-01.jpg], total top-of-head ~5.5 m above plaza [est]. Pedestal is surrounded by offerings, flower garlands, marigold chains, and the plaza is always busy with worshippers. Statue by Silpa Bhirasri, designed by Phra Thewaphinimmit, unveiled 15 Jan 1934 (B.E. 2477). Registered by Fine Arts Dept 3 Jan 1937. SACRED — no collision damage, no destruction, no comedic use; make it a non-destructible, softly lit focal point.
refs: https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/ท้าวสุรนารี

landmarks.name_th: ประตูชุมพล
landmarks.notes: Directly behind (east of) the monument. The only one of the original 4 city gates still standing (King Narai era, 1656-1688). OSM footprint 43 m N-S x 11 m E-W including the flanking wall stubs. Opening ~3 m wide (Thai Wikipedia: 'ประตูเมืองกว้าง 3 เมตร'). Body: thick white-plastered masonry (laterite/brick) wall ~6 m high (Wikipedia: wall height 6 m) with Thai-style rounded merlons (ใบเสมา) on top; above the arch sits a 2-tier wooden watch-tower with dark-red / maroon wooden walls and a layered Thai gable roof in red-brown clay tiles with white chofa/bai raka trim (gate-02.jpg). Total height ~12-14 m [est from gate-02.jpg]. Lit warm gold at night (gate-01.jpg). Locals call it 'บ้านย่าโม' — do not let the car drive on top of it.
refs: https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/ประตูเมืองนครราชสีมา

landmarks.name_th: กำแพงเมืองและคูเมือง (ช่วงประตูชุมพล / ฝั่งตะวันตก)
landmarks.notes: Old city is a rectangle ~1,000 x 1,700 m. Original moat 20 m wide x 6 m deep, wall 6 m high, 5,220 m around, 4,302 merlons, 15 forts (Thai Wikipedia). Today only short wall segments remain next to Chumphon Gate; elsewhere the moat survives as a concrete/stone-edged canal 23-40 m wide (OSM water=moat polygons) lined with rain trees and footpaths, roads on both sides (clocktower-01.jpg, skyline-01.jpg). West moat runs N-S on both sides of the gate (OSM ways 544097478, 544097480, 544097467); part of the west moat was filled in to build the monument plaza. North moat runs E-W ~540 m north of the monument; south moat ~500 m south. Full moat polygons in footprints.geojson.
refs: https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/ประตูเมืองนครราชสีมา

landmarks.name_th: ลานอนุสาวรีย์ท้าวสุรนารี (ลานย่าโม)
landmarks.notes: OSM landuse=recreation_ground polygon, long axis N-S, wraps the monument terrace and extends north toward the light-and-sound pavilion and Lan Lang Pratu Mueang. Light-grey stone paving, wide stairs up to the terrace, ornate lamp posts with globe lights (gate-01.jpg). Annual Ya Mo festival 23 Mar - 3 Apr with stalls; light-and-sound show here. Pedestrian space — race route should pass around it on the road, not across it.

landmarks.name_th: หอนาฬิกา (หน้าศาลากลาง)
landmarks.notes: Slim white square tower with a clock face on each side and a small pointed spire, at the moat edge in front of the Provincial Hall (clocktower-01.jpg, seen across the west moat). Footprint from OSM; height ~15 m [est from photo].

landmarks.name_th: ศาลากลางจังหวัดนครราชสีมา
landmarks.notes: 3-storey government building, cream/white walls with white pilasters, steep layered Thai gable roofs in orange-red tiles with white bargeboards and chofa finials, central entrance porch under a tall gable with royal portrait and Garuda emblem (provincial-hall-01.jpg, Jan 2026). Long axis N-S. Height: 3 floors + tall roof ≈ 16 m [est]. The open field in front hosts the Ya Mo festival fair. Government building — keep signage respectful; do not deface with ads.

Height ~28 m [est, 7 floors x 4 m]. Photo is taken across water — exact viewpoint [ยังไม่ยืนยัน].

landmarks.name_th: เทอร์มินอล 21 โคราช
landmarks.notes: Tallest skyline element seen from the plaza (NW, ~1.2 km). Mall 7 floors + 1 basement, 'Skydeck' tower 110 m, 9-storey car park, Centre Point hotel 18 floors (Thai Wikipedia). Airport-terminal theme: interior has a full-size airliner model and a red torii gate (terminal21-01/03.jpg are INTERIOR shots — exterior refs still needed from Street View). Use as a distant silhouette / skyline beacon; 110 m height applies to the tower only. Opened 19 Dec 2016. Avoid any reference to the Feb 2020 shooting incident in game content.
refs: https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/เทอร์มินอล_21_โคราช
